what: MACHAMP ablation of generation 4 — which net lost the games. Written 2026-09-25 BEFORE the first ablation game or the Candidate B fit. No new self-play: both candidates come from the gen4 round's data (solver/out/selfplay/eaa5becc54eb/r2-sp1, built into solver/out/machamp/eaa5becc54eb/cand4/).
hypothesis: gen4's DODUO, distilled toward a 4-row search mix, drifted +0.051 nats from the human clone and is what cost the games; its PORYGON2 is neutral or helps.

A.what: DODUO frozen at gen0 (MAG v1 + DODUO v1) + gen4's PORYGON2 (solver/machamp/models/gen4/porygon2-gen4.json), no training

B.what: a NEW DODUO refit from DODUO v1 on the same gen4 targets with a much stronger pull to the human clone + gen0's PORYGON2 (v0)
B.fit: solver/machamp/train_doduo.py, beta 0.7 (target = 0.3 search mix + 0.7 DODUO v1; rounds 1-2 used beta 0.3: 0.7 search mix + 0.3 DODUO v1), human-weight 3.0 (was 1.0), 3 epochs, lr 3e-4, the same selection rule (lowest self-play val CE among epochs within +0.05 nats of v1 on human val)

match: each candidate vs the champion gen0-r2 (MAG v1 + DODUO v1 + PORYGON2 v0): 100 held-out TEST pairs from data/team-pool-frozen-regmc x 2 seats = 200 games, pair seed 1, battle seed 7041 (A) and 7051 (B), both sides MILTANK k 4x4, 1000 ms, depth 0, 3 workers

reading.helps: Wilson 95% lower bound of the candidate's score > 0.5
reading.no_detectable_effect: otherwise (the interval contains 0.5); at n = 200 an effect under about 7 points is not resolvable
reading.context: gen4 (both nets changed) scored 0.475 [0.407, 0.544] against the same champion on the same 100 pairs with battle seed 7031; gen3 scored 0.430 [0.363, 0.499]

also_reported: Candidate B's held-out human joint log-loss against DODUO v1 (the drift the stronger pull is meant to cut), paired, player-clustered
